Alain-René Lesage, Gil Blas, translated by Tobias Smollett.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/alain-rene-lesage/gil-blas/tobias-smollett

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Alain-René Lesage, the author, died 1747 (UK for the text used (1748 English translation by the British translator Tobias Smollett); original French 1715-1735).
- Tobias Smollett, the translator, died 1771.

First publication of the text used: 1748 (SE colophon: 'Gil Blas was published between 1715 and 1735 by Alain-René Lesage. It was translated from French in 1748 by Tobias Smollett').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1748, before 1931;
  a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after
  publication, so this work entered it in 1843.
- Country of origin (UK for the text used (1748 English translation by the British translator Tobias Smollett); original French 1715-1735): copyright there lasts for life plus 70 years
  after the death of the last surviving person named above. The last to die
  did so in 1771, so the work entered the public domain there on
  1 January 1842.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: original 1715-1735, Smollett translation 1748; no editor/introducer mentioned
- Wikidata Q267962 (Alain-René Lesage, 'French writer 1668-1747'), P570 = 1747-11-17
- Wikidata Q356283 (Tobias Smollett, 'Scottish writer and surgeon 1721-1771'), P570 = 1771-09-17
